# Akbar Travels

> India's leading online travel booking platform offering domestic and international flight tickets with exclusive airfare deals and discounts.

Akbar Travels provides comprehensive flight booking services across India, featuring routes from major cities like Bangalore (BLR), New Delhi, and Ahmedabad, as well as regional destinations including Agatti Island (AGX), Dabolim South Goa, and Shivamogga (RQY). The platform offers competitive pricing, travel discounts, and seamless booking experiences for domestic travelers.
